question: At what CO2 flow rates were System 1 (the CO2 jet) and System 2 (the microbubbles) run, and what pore size did the microbubble diffuser have?
expect: System 1 6 L/min; System 2 0.5 L/min through a 2 μm stainless-steel diffuser (sec. 2.2.1-2.2.2)
rendered:
<document title="Evaluating CO2 Capture in Aqueous Amine Solution by Using a New Microbubble System">

=== page 3 ===
- 2.2.1. System 1. System 1 for CO2 capture was carried out employing a CO2 jet that was directly injected by a needle into the amine solutions (Figure 1) at a controlled flow rate of 6 L/min.

=== page 4 ===
- CO2 microbubbles were directly injected into the amine solutions (Table 2), using a stainless-steel diffuser with a porous size of 2 μm, at a controlled flow rate of 0.5 L/min.

The answer is: System 1 was run at a CO2 flow rate of 6 L/min, and System 2 was run at a CO2 flow rate of 0.5 L/min. The microbubble diffuser had a pore size of 2 μm. The document title is "Evaluating CO2 Capture in Aqueous Amine Solution by Using a New Microbubble System".
